title: Minecart Madness
description:
Mojang wants to improve minecarts with some recently added experimental features. In this video we explore these features and their implications for minecraft and the limitations of it's physics engine. Because it turns out when you make minecarts go faster, simulated aeodynamics become a significant limiting factor in their speed.
